WITH county_stats AS (
    SELECT SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") * 1.0 / SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") AS county_avg_rate
    FROM frpm
    WHERE "County Name" = 'Alameda' AND "Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
),
school_rates AS (
    SELECT CDSCode,
           "School Name",
           "Charter School (Y/N)",
           "Low Grade",
           "High Grade",
           "Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / "Enrollment (K-12)" AS free_meal_rate
    FROM frpm
    WHERE "County Name" = 'Alameda' AND "Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
    ORDER BY free_meal_rate DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    sr."School Name",
    CASE WHEN sr."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_charter,
    sr."Low Grade" || '-' || sr."High Grade" AS grades_served,
    CASE
        WHEN ss.cds IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS sat_performance_level,
    sr.free_meal_rate - cs.county_avg_rate AS deviation_from_county_avg
FROM school_rates sr
CROSS JOIN county_stats cs
LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON sr.CDSCode = ss.cds

SELECT `School Name`, CAST(`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation School'
  AND `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.State,
    s.Latitude,
    s.Longitude,
    strftime('%Y', s.OpenDate) AS OpenYear,
    CASE WHEN s.ClosedDate IS NULL THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Closed' END AS Status,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS Enrollment,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS FRPM_Rate,
    CASE 
        WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 75 THEN 'High FRPM'
        WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 50 THEN 'Medium FRPM'
        ELSE 'Low FRPM'
    END AS FRPM_Category,
    sat.AvgScrRead,
    sat.AvgScrMath,
    sat.AvgScrWrite,
    (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgTotalScore,
    sat.NumTstTakr,
    sat.NumGE1500,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS Rank_By_TotalScore
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
  AND s.Charter = 1
ORDER BY FRPM_Category, Rank_By_TotalScore;

SELECT 
    f.`School Name` AS school_name,
    s.Street AS street,
    s.City AS city,
    s.Zip AS zip,
    s.State AS state,
    s.MailStreet AS mailing_street,
    s.MailCity AS mailing_city,
    s.MailZip AS mailing_zip,
    s.MailState AS mailing_state,
    s.Website AS website,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment_k12,
    f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS free_meal_count_k12,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS pct_eligible_free_k12,
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS frpm_count_k12,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS pct_eligible_frpm_k12,
    sa.enroll12 AS sat_enroll12,
    sa.NumTstTakr AS sat_test_takers,
    sa.AvgScrRead AS sat_avg_read,
    sa.AvgScrMath AS sat_avg_math,
    sa.AvgScrWrite AS sat_avg_write,
    sa.NumGE1500 AS sat_num_ge1500,
    CASE 
        WHEN sa.NumTstTakr > 0 THEN ROUND(sa.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / sa.NumTstTakr, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS sat_pct_ge1500,
    CASE
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 70 
            AND (sa.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / sa.NumTstTakr) > 20 
        THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` < 30 
            AND (sa.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / sa.NumTstTakr) < 10 
        THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM'
        ELSE 'Neither'
    END AS performance_assessment
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON f.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 0 
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 100
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Direct'
  AND s.OpenDate > '2000-01-01'

SELECT 
    s.sname AS School_Name,
    s.dname AS District,
    s.cname AS County,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS Total_Enrollment,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS FRPM_Percent,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 75 THEN 'High Poverty'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 50 THEN 'Medium Poverty'
        ELSE 'Low Poverty'
    END AS Poverty_Level,
    sc.AvgScrMath,
    (sc.AvgScrRead + sc.AvgScrMath + sc.AvgScrWrite) AS Total_SAT_Score,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sc.AvgScrRead + sc.AvgScrMath + sc.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS SAT_Performance_Rank
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
  AND sc.AvgScrMath > 400
ORDER BY Total_SAT_Score DESC;

SELECT
    s.sname AS school_name,
    s.dname AS district_name,
    s.cname AS county_name,
    s.enroll12,
    s.NumTstTakr,
    s.AvgScrRead,
    s.AvgScrMath,
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) AS total_avg_sat,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS rank,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS frpm_percent,
    CASE
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` <= 25 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` <= 50 THEN 'Medium-Low'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` <= 75 THEN 'Medium-High'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS poverty_level,
    CASE
        WHEN (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) >= 2100 THEN 'Excellent'
        WHEN (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) >= 1800 THEN 'Good'
        WHEN (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Below Average'
    END AS performance_category
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
JOIN frpm f ON sch.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE sch.Magnet = 1 AND s.NumTstTakr > 500
ORDER BY total_avg_sat DESC;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
ORDER BY sc.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    fr."School Name",
    s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State,
    fr."School Type", fr."District Type", fr."Charter School (Y/N)", s.Charter, s.FundingType,
    fr."Enrollment (K-12)",
    fr."Free Meal Count (K-12)",
    fr."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)",
    fr."FRPM Count (K-12)",
    fr."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
    sa.enroll12 AS sat_enroll12,
    sa.NumTstTakr,
    sa.AvgScrRead, sa.AvgScrMath, sa.AvgScrWrite,
    sa.NumGE1500
FROM frpm fr
LEFT JOIN schools s ON fr.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON fr.CDSCode = sa.cds
ORDER BY fr."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath > 560
AND schools.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT s.CDSCode, s.County, s.District, s.School, s.Street, s.StreetAbr, s.City, s.Zip, s.State, s.Phone, s.Website, s.Latitude, s.Longitude, s.Charter, s.CharterNum, s.FundingType AS SchoolFundingType, sat.enroll12, sat.NumTstTakr, sat.AvgScrRead, sat.AvgScrMath, sat.AvgScrWrite, sat.NumGE1500, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)`, f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`, f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`, f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`, f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)`, f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`, f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`, f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`, f.`NSLP Provision Status`, f.`Charter School (Y/N)`, f.`Charter School Number`, f.`Charter Funding Type` AS FRPMCharterFundingType FROM satscores sat JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode LEFT JOIN frpm f ON sat.cds = f.CDSCode WHERE sat.NumTstTakr > 10 ORDER BY sat.AvgScrRead DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    s.County,
    s.School,
    f.`District Name`,
    (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS total_enrollment,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS frpm_percent,
    f.`Charter School (Y/N)` AS charter_school,
    sa.AvgScrRead,
    sa.AvgScrMath,
    sa.AvgScrWrite,
    (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) AS total_sat_score,
    (sa.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / sa.NumTstTakr) AS pct_ge1500,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 75 THEN 'High'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 50 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS frpm_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) DESC) AS county_enroll_rank,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE 
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 75 THEN 'High'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 50 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END ORDER BY (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS category_sat_rank
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 500
  AND (
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 60 
    OR (sa.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL AND sa.NumTstTakr > 0 AND (sa.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / sa.NumTstTakr) > 0.3)
  )
ORDER BY s.County, frpm_category, county_enroll_rank;

SELECT *
FROM (
    WITH active_schools AS (
        SELECT * FROM schools WHERE StatusType = 'Active'
    ),
    free_meal_all AS (
        SELECT f.CDSCode, f."County Name" AS county, 
               f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS free_count, 
               f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enroll,
               CASE WHEN f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0 
                    THEN f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" 
                    ELSE NULL END AS free_meal_rate
        FROM frpm f
        JOIN active_schools a ON f.CDSCode = a.CDSCode
    ),
    county_max AS (
        SELECT county, MAX(free_meal_rate) AS max_free_rate
        FROM free_meal_all
        WHERE free_meal_rate IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY county
    ),
    sat_excel AS (
        SELECT cds, sname, dname, cname, 
               NumGE1500 * 1.0 / NumTstTakr AS sat_excellence_rate,
               NumTstTakr, NumGE1500, AvgScrRead, AvgScrMath, AvgScrWrite
        FROM satscores
        WHERE NumTstTakr > 0 AND (NumGE1500 * 1.0 / NumTstTakr) > 0.3
    )
    SELECT sch.*,
           f.free_count AS "Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)",
           f.enroll AS "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)",
           f.free_meal_rate AS "Free Meal Eligibility Rate",
           sat.sat_excellence_rate AS "SAT Excellence Rate",
           sat.NumTstTakr, sat.NumGE1500,
           sat.AvgScrRead, sat.AvgScrMath, sat.AvgScrWrite
    FROM sat_excel sat
    JOIN free_meal_all f ON sat.cds = f.CDSCode
    JOIN county_max cm ON f.county = cm.county AND f.free_meal_rate = cm.max_free_rate
    JOIN schools sch ON sat.cds = sch.CDSCode
    ORDER BY f.free_meal_rate DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT s.sname AS school_name,
       CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr AS excellence_rate,
       sch.Phone,
       sch.City,
       CASE WHEN sch.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS charter_status,
       f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS poverty_rate,
       CASE
           WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 75 THEN 'High Poverty'
           WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 50 THEN 'Medium Poverty'
           WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 25 THEN 'Low Poverty'
           ELSE 'Very Low Poverty'
       END AS poverty_classification
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
JOIN frpm f ON sch.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY excellence_rate DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT s.NCESSchool
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.District
FROM satscores sc
JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active' AND sc.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(sc.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Merged' AND schools.County = 'Alameda' AND satscores.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS Rank,
       s.sname AS SchoolName,
       sc.CharterNum AS CharterNumber,
       s.AvgScrWrite AS AverageWritingScore
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN s.NumTstTakr < 50 THEN 'under 50'
        WHEN s.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN '50-100'
        WHEN s.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 101 AND 250 THEN '100-250'
    END AS test_volume_category,
    COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
    ROUND(AVG(s.enroll12), 1) AS avg_enroll12,
    ROUND(AVG(s.NumTstTakr), 1) AS avg_num_test_takers,
    ROUND(AVG(s.AvgScrRead), 1) AS avg_read_score,
    ROUND(AVG(s.AvgScrMath), 1) AS avg_math_score,
    ROUND(AVG(s.AvgScrWrite), 1) AS avg_write_score,
    ROUND(AVG(s.NumGE1500), 1) AS avg_num_ge1500,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(s.NumTstTakr, 0)), 1) AS avg_pct_ge1500
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno'
  AND sc.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
  AND sc.Charter = 1
  AND s.NumTstTakr <= 250
GROUP BY test_volume_category
ORDER BY MIN(s.NumTstTakr);

SELECT
    satscores.sname AS school_name,
    schools.Street,
    schools.City,
    schools.State,
    schools.Zip,
    schools.Phone,
    schools.Website,
    satscores.enroll12,
    satscores.NumTstTakr,
    satscores.AvgScrRead,
    satscores.AvgScrMath,
    satscores.AvgScrWrite,
    satscores.NumGE1500,
    frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)` AS charter_status,
    frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment_k12,
    frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS pct_frpm
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
JOIN frpm ON satscores.cds = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND satscores.NumTstTakr >= 10
  AND satscores.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_schools,
    AVG(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS avg_enrollment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 OR f."Charter School (Y/N)" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_count,
    AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") AS avg_poverty_rate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f."District Code") AS number_of_districts,
    AVG(s.AvgScrRead) AS avg_sat_read,
    AVG(s.AvgScrMath) AS avg_sat_math,
    AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_sat_write,
    AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS avg_sat_testtakers,
    (SELECT f2."School Name"
     FROM frpm f2
     WHERE f2."County Name" = 'Amador'
       AND f2."Low Grade" = '9'
       AND f2."High Grade" = '12'
     ORDER BY f2."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS largest_school_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_poverty_count
FROM frpm f
LEFT JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Amador'
  AND f."Low Grade" = '9'
  AND f."High Grade" = '12';

SELECT AVG(f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` * 100) AS avg_free_meal_percentage,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.Charter = 0 OR s.Charter IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_count,
       AVG((sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) / 3.0) AS avg_sat_score,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 600 THEN 1 END) AS very_high_free_meal_count,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500 AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` <= 600 THEN 1 END) AS high_free_meal_count
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON f.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700

SELECT sname
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.`School Name`,
       schools.Street || ', ' || schools.City || ', ' || schools.State || ' ' || schools.Zip AS FullStreetAddress
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE (frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` - frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30;

SELECT DISTINCT f."School Name"
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
  AND CAST(f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS REAL) / f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0.1
  AND s.NumGE1500 > 0;

SELECT s.sname, f.`Educational Option Type`
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.cname = 'Riverside' AND s.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Monterey'
  AND f."School Type" LIKE '%High%'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800;

SELECT s.School, sc.AvgScrWrite, s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31'
   OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01';

SELECT s.School AS Name, s.DOCType
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE LOWER(s.FundingType) = 'locally funded'
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
  AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (
      SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
      FROM frpm f2
      JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE LOWER(s2.FundingType) = 'locally funded'
        AND f2."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
        AND f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."Low Grade" = '1' AND f."High Grade" = '12'
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL AND s.City IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    frpm."School Name",
    frpm."County Name",
    frpm."District Name",
    schools.Street,
    schools.City,
    schools.Zip,
    schools.State,
    frpm."School Type",
    frpm."Charter School (Y/N)",
    frpm."Low Grade",
    frpm."High Grade",
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)",
    frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)",
    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)",
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)",
    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
    satscores.enroll12,
    satscores.NumTstTakr,
    satscores.AvgScrRead,
    satscores.AvgScrMath,
    satscores.AvgScrWrite,
    satscores.NumGE1500
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
ORDER BY frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.District AS district,
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS frpm_count,
    ROUND(f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / NULLIF(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 0), 2) AS eligibility_rate,
    sat.AvgScrRead AS avg_read,
    sat.AvgScrMath AS avg_math,
    sat.AvgScrWrite AS avg_write,
    sat.NumTstTakr AS sat_takers,
    sat.NumGE1500 AS num_ge1500,
    ROUND(sat.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / NULLIF(sat.NumTstTakr, 0), 2) AS high_scorer_rate
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON f.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.School, s.Website
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode

SELECT

    ss.dname AS district,
    ss.AvgScrRead AS avg_read,
    ss.AvgScrMath AS avg_math,
    ss.AvgScrWrite AS avg_write,
    ss.total_score AS total_sat,
    r.overall_rank AS rank_total_score,
    ss.frpm_pct AS frpm_eligibility_rate_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN ss.enrollment_k12 > 0 THEN (ss.NumTstTakr * 100.0 / ss.enrollment_k12)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS test_participation_rate_pct,
    daw.avg_write_district AS district_avg_write,
    ss.AvgScrWrite - daw.avg_write_district AS writing_diff_from_district
FROM (
    SELECT
        s.cds,
        s.sname,
        s.dname,
        s.AvgScrRead,
        s.AvgScrMath,
        s.AvgScrWrite,
        (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) AS total_score,
        s.NumTstTakr,
        f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
        f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_pct
    FROM satscores s
    INNER JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
    LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
    WHERE (sch.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND sch.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
       OR (sch.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND sch.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
       OR (sch.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND sch.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich')
) ss
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        cds,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_score DESC) AS overall_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cds,
            AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite AS total_score
        FROM satscores
        WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
          AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
          AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
    )
) r ON ss.cds = r.cds
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        dname,
        AVG(AvgScrWrite) AS avg_write_district
    FROM satscores
    WHERE AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY dname
) daw ON ss.dname = daw.dname
ORDER BY ss.total_score DESC;

SELECT
    CAST(m.colusa_schools AS REAL) / NULLIF(m.humboldt_schools, 0) AS ratio_total_schools,
    CAST(m.colusa_charter AS REAL) / NULLIF(m.humboldt_charter, 0) AS ratio_charter_schools,
    CAST(m.colusa_high_frpm AS REAL) / NULLIF(m.humboldt_high_frpm, 0) AS ratio_high_frpm_schools,
    s.colusa_avg_sat / NULLIF(s.humboldt_avg_sat, 0) AS ratio_average_sat_score,
    CAST(m.colusa_frpm_total AS REAL) / NULLIF(m.humboldt_frpm_total, 0) AS ratio_total_frpm,
    CAST(m.colusa_enrollment AS REAL) / NULLIF(m.humboldt_enrollment, 0) AS ratio_total_enrollment
FROM (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.County = 'Colusa' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS colusa_schools,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.County = 'Humboldt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS humboldt_schools,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.County = 'Colusa' AND s.Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS colusa_charter,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.County = 'Humboldt' AND s.Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS humboldt_charter,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.County = 'Colusa' AND f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS colusa_high_frpm,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.County = 'Humboldt' AND f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS humboldt_high_frpm,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.County = 'Colusa' THEN f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` ELSE 0 END) AS colusa_frpm_total,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.County = 'Humboldt' THEN f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` ELSE 0 END) AS humboldt_frpm_total,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.County = 'Colusa' THEN f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ELSE 0 END) AS colusa_enrollment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.County = 'Humboldt' THEN f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ELSE 0 END) AS humboldt_enrollment
    FROM schools s
    LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE s.County IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt')
) m
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT
        AVG(CASE WHEN cname = 'Colusa' THEN AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite END) AS colusa_avg_sat,
        AVG(CASE WHEN cname = 'Humboldt' THEN AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite END) AS humboldt_avg_sat
    FROM satscores
    WHERE cname IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt')
      AND AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL

      AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
) s

all_ranked AS (

           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY free_meal_percent) AS rank_in_county

low_free AS (

SELECT 
    td.School,
    td.District,
    td.enrollment,
    td.frpm_pct,

    ca.avg_enrollment AS county_avg_enrollment,
    ca.avg_frpm_pct AS county_avg_frpm_pct,
    ca.avg_total_score AS county_avg_sat_total,
    ca.avg_read AS county_avg_read,
    ca.avg_math AS county_avg_math,
    ca.avg_write AS county_avg_write,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY td.frpm_pct DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank_frpm_pct,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY td.total_score DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank_sat_performance
FROM (
    SELECT ts.CDSCode, ts.School, ts.District, ts.OpenDate,
           lf.enrollment, lf.frpm_pct, lf.frpm_count,
           sats.AvgScrRead, sats.AvgScrMath, sats.AvgScrWrite, sats.total_score, sats.NumTstTakr
    FROM (
        SELECT CDSCode, School, District, OpenDate
        FROM schools
        WHERE County = 'Stanislaus'
          AND FundingType = 'Directly funded'
          AND OpenDate >= '2000-01-01'
          AND OpenDate <= '2005-12-31'
    ) ts
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT f.CDSCode, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
               f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_pct,
               f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count
        FROM frpm f
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT CDSCode, MAX("Academic Year") AS max_year
            FROM frpm
            WHERE CDSCode IN (
                SELECT CDSCode FROM schools WHERE County = 'Stanislaus'
            )
            GROUP BY CDSCode
        ) latest ON f.CDSCode = latest.CDSCode AND f."Academic Year" = latest.max_year
    ) lf ON ts.CDSCode = lf.CDSCode
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT cds, AvgScrRead, AvgScrMath, AvgScrWrite, NumTstTakr, NumGE1500,
               (AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS total_score
        FROM satscores
        WHERE cds IN (
            SELECT CDSCode FROM schools WHERE County = 'Stanislaus'
        )
    ) sats ON ts.CDSCode = sats.cds
) td
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT AVG(lfa.enrollment) AS avg_enrollment,
           AVG(lfa.frpm_pct) AS avg_frpm_pct,
           AVG(ss.total_score) AS avg_total_score,
           AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) AS avg_read,
           AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) AS avg_math,
           AVG(ss.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_write
    FROM (
        SELECT CDSCode FROM schools WHERE County = 'Stanislaus'
    ) all_schools
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT f.CDSCode, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
               f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_pct
        FROM frpm f
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT CDSCode, MAX("Academic Year") AS max_year
            FROM frpm
            WHERE CDSCode IN (
                SELECT CDSCode FROM schools WHERE County = 'Stanislaus'
            )
            GROUP BY CDSCode
        ) latest ON f.CDSCode = latest.CDSCode AND f."Academic Year" = latest.max_year
    ) lfa ON all_schools.CDSCode = lfa.CDSCode
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT cds, AvgScrRead, AvgScrMath, AvgScrWrite,
               (AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS total_score
        FROM satscores
        WHERE cds IN (
            SELECT CDSCode FROM schools WHERE County = 'Stanislaus'
        )
    ) ss ON all_schools.CDSCode = ss.cds
) ca
ORDER BY td.School;

SELECT

    SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_enrollment_k12,

    SUM(f."FRPM Count (K-12)") AS total_frpm_count,
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)")), 2) AS avg_frpm_percent,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)") > 75 THEN 1 END) AS poverty_high_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)") BETWEEN 50 AND 75 THEN 1 END) AS poverty_medium_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)") < 50 THEN 1 END) AS poverty_low_count,
    ROUND(AVG(sat.AvgScrRead), 2) AS avg_sat_read,
    ROUND(AVG(sat.AvgScrMath), 2) AS avg_sat_math,
    ROUND(AVG(sat.AvgScrWrite), 2) AS avg_sat_write,
    ROUND(AVG(sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite), 2) AS avg_sat_total
FROM schools s
JOIN common_grade cg ON s.GSserved = cg.GSserved
LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.City = 'Adelanto'
  AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY cg.GSserved

SELECT 'County' AS Type, County, Virtual_Count, Charter_Count, Regular_Count, Total_Enrollment, Avg_FRPM_Pct, Avg_SAT_Total, NULL AS School_Name, NULL AS School_Enrollment
FROM (
    SELECT
        v.County,
        COUNT(*) AS Virtual_Count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN v.Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Charter_Count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN v.Charter != 1 OR v.Charter IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Regular_Count,
        SUM(v.Enrollment) AS Total_Enrollment,
        AVG(v.FRPM_Pct) AS Avg_FRPM_Pct,
        AVG(CASE WHEN v.HasSAT THEN v.SAT_Total END) AS Avg_SAT_Total
    FROM (
        SELECT
            sch.CDSCode,
            sch.County,
            sch.School AS SchoolName,
            frpm."Charter School (Y/N)" AS Charter,
            frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS Enrollment,
            frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS FRPM_Pct,
            (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) AS SAT_Total,
            sat.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND sat.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND sat.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL AS HasSAT
        FROM schools sch
        JOIN frpm ON sch.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
        LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sch.CDSCode = sat.cds
        WHERE sch.County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
          AND sch.Virtual = 'F'
    ) v
    GROUP BY v.County
) county_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Largest School' AS Type, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, School_Name, School_Enrollment

    WHERE sch.County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')

SELECT frpm."School Type" AS "School Type", schools.School AS "School Name", schools.Latitude AS "Latitude"

SELECT a.first_name, a.District

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
JOIN district dist ON cl.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE c.type = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND dist.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_unemployment_year FROM district

WITH eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id, A3, A11
    FROM district
    WHERE A11 BETWEEN 6000 AND 10000
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT district_id,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY A3 ORDER BY A11 DESC) AS rnk
    FROM eligible_districts
),
top3_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rnk <= 3
),
districts_with_enough_females AS (
    SELECT c.district_id
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM top3_districts)
    GROUP BY c.district_id
    HAVING COUNT(c.client_id) >= 5
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) AS female_client_count,
       COUNT(l.loan_id) AS active_loan_count,
       SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
       AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM client cl
JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE cl.gender = 'F'
  AND cl.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM districts_with_enough_females)

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT a.account_id, (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id

JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (
    SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
    FROM client c2
    JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id
    WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
      AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id

  AND dist.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT o.gender,
       o.age_group,
       d.A3 AS region,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.account_id) AS num_accounts,
       AVG(COALESCE(t.total_income, 0)) AS avg_total_income,
       AVG(COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0)) AS avg_total_expense,
       AVG(COALESCE(t.net_income, 0)) AS avg_net_income,
       AVG(lb.balance) AS avg_last_balance
FROM (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, c.gender,
           CASE 
               WHEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - 
                    (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) < 30 THEN 'Young'
               WHEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - 
                    (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN 'Middle-aged'
               ELSE 'Senior'
           END AS age_group
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
) o
JOIN district d ON o.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - 
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_income
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE')
    GROUP BY account_id
) t ON o.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, balance
    FROM (
        SELECT account_id, balance,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY date DESC) AS rn
        FROM trans
        WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE')
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
) lb ON o.account_id = lb.account_id
GROUP BY o.gender, o.age_group, d.A3
ORDER BY o.gender, o.age_group, d.A3;

SELECT c.client_id,
       c.gender,
       c.birth_date,
       d.A2 AS district_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l_active.loan_id) AS active_loan_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(l_active.amount), 0) AS total_active_loan_amount,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l_completed.loan_id) AS completed_loan_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(l_completed.amount), 0) AS total_completed_loan_amount,
       COALESCE(AVG(l_all.duration), 0) AS avg_loan_duration,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id) AS transaction_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(ABS(t.amount)), 0) AS transaction_volume,
       COALESCE(AVG(t.balance), 0) AS avg_balance,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS card_count,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cd.type) AS card_types,
       MIN(cd.issued) AS first_card_issued,
       MAX(cd.issued) AS last_card_issued,
       CASE
           WHEN COALESCE(SUM(ABS(t.amount)), 0) > 1000000 THEN 'High'
           WHEN COALESCE(SUM(ABS(t.amount)), 0) > 100000 THEN 'Medium'
           ELSE 'Low'
       END AS service_category
FROM disp dsp
JOIN account ac ON dsp.account_id = ac.account_id
JOIN client c ON dsp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l_active ON dsp.account_id = l_active.account_id AND l_active.status = 'A'
LEFT JOIN loan l_completed ON dsp.account_id = l_completed.account_id AND l_completed.status = 'B'
LEFT JOIN loan l_all ON dsp.account_id = l_all.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans t ON dsp.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN card cd ON dsp.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE dsp.type = 'DISPONENT'
  AND ac.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
GROUP BY c.client_id,
         c.gender,
         c.birth_date,
         d.A2
ORDER BY transaction_volume DESC;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND l.status = 'A'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  AND l.amount = (
    SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
    FROM loan l2
    JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
    WHERE l2.duration > 12
      AND l2.status = 'A'
      AND strftime('%Y', a2.date) = '1993'
  );

SELECT
    (SELECT AVG(CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER))
     FROM client c
     JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
     JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
     JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
     WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01') AS avg_age,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
     FROM client c
     JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
     JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
     JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
     WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01') AS total_with_loans,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
     FROM client c
     JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
     JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
     JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
     WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01' AND l.status = 'A') AS completed_loans,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
     FROM client c
     JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
     JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
     JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
     WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01' AND l.status = 'D') AS in_debt,
    (SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER))
     FROM client c
     JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
     JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
     JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
     WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01') AS earliest_year,
    (SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER))
     FROM client c
     JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
     JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
     JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
     WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01') AS latest_year;

SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM trans
WHERE date = (
    SELECT MIN(date)
    FROM trans
    WHERE date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
)
AND date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
INNER JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
AND t.balance > 3000
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM trans t2
    WHERE t2.account_id = t.account_id
    AND (t2.date > t.date OR (t2.date = t.date AND t2.trans_id > t.trans_id))
)

SELECT tc.client_id, tc.gender, tc.birth_date, tc.age_at_issue, cc.card_ids, cc.card_count, ca.account_ids, ca.account_count,
       COALESCE(cl.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count, COALESCE(cl.active_loan_count, 0) AS active_loan_count,
       COALESCE(cl.total_loan_amount, 0) AS total_loan_amount, COALESCE(cl.avg_loan_amount, 0) AS avg_loan_amount,
       cl.loan_ids, COALESCE(ct.trans_count, 0) AS trans_count, COALESCE(ct.total_trans_amount, 0) AS total_trans_amount,
       COALESCE(ct.avg_balance, 0) AS avg_balance, COALESCE(ct.total_credit, 0) AS total_credit,
       COALESCE(ct.total_debit, 0) AS total_debit, d.*,
       CASE
           WHEN COALESCE(cl.loan_count, 0) > 0 AND tc.age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'
           WHEN COALESCE(cl.loan_count, 0) > 0 AND tc.age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower'
           ELSE 'Non-borrower'
       END AS borrower_category,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.gender ORDER BY tc.age_at_issue ASC) AS age_rank_in_gender
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.district_id,
           (strftime('%Y', '1994-03-03') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) - 
           (strftime('%m-%d', '1994-03-03') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date))) AS age_at_issue
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
    WHERE cd.issued = '1994-03-03'
) tc
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.client_id, GROUP_CONCAT(cd.card_id, ', ') AS card_ids, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
    WHERE cd.issued = '1994-03-03'
    GROUP BY c.client_id
) cc ON tc.client_id = cc.client_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.client_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_count,
           SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount, GROUP_CONCAT(l.loan_id, ', ') AS loan_ids
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE c.client_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT c2.client_id FROM client c2
        JOIN disp d2 ON c2.client_id = d2.client_id
        JOIN card cd2 ON d2.disp_id = cd2.disp_id
        WHERE cd2.issued = '1994-03-03'
    )
    GROUP BY c.client_id
) cl ON tc.client_id = cl.client_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.client_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS trans_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total_trans_amount,
           AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'debit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_debit
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE c.client_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT c2.client_id FROM client c2
        JOIN disp d2 ON c2.client_id = d2.client_id
        JOIN card cd2 ON d2.disp_id = cd2.disp_id
        WHERE cd2.issued = '1994-03-03'
    )
    GROUP BY c.client_id
) ct ON tc.client_id = ct.client_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c.client_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS account_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d.account_id, ', ') AS account_ids
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE c.client_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT c2.client_id FROM client c2
        JOIN disp d2 ON c2.client_id = d2.client_id
        JOIN card cd2 ON d2.disp_id = cd2.disp_id
        WHERE cd2.issued = '1994-03-03'
    )
    GROUP BY c.client_id
) ca ON tc.client_id = ca.client_id
LEFT JOIN district d ON tc.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY tc.gender, age_rank_in_gender;

SELECT
    t.trans_id,
    t.amount,
    t.date AS transaction_date,
    a.date AS account_opened_date,
    CAST(julianday('1998-10-14') - julianday(a.date) AS INTEGER) AS days_since_opened,
    c.gender,
    (strftime('%Y', '1998-10-14') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - 
        (strftime('%m-%d', '1998-10-14') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS age,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE account_id = t.account_id AND date <= '1998-10-14') AS total_transactions,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) 
     FROM disp di 
     JOIN card ca ON di.disp_id = ca.disp_id 
     WHERE di.account_id = t.account_id) AS number_of_cards,
    CASE 
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan WHERE account_id = t.account_id AND date < '1998-10-14') 
        THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS had_loan_before
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE t.date = '1998-10-14' AND t.amount = 840;

SELECT
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    d.A11 AS average_salary,
    d.A12 AS unemployment_rate_95,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM district d2 WHERE d2.A11 > d.A11) + 1 AS salary_rank,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM district d2 WHERE d2.A12 < d.A12) + 1 AS unemployment_rank,
    JULIANDAY(l.date) - JULIANDAY(a.date) AS days_open,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client WHERE district_id = a.district_id) AS total_clients_in_district,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client WHERE district_id = a.district_id AND gender = 'M') AS male_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client WHERE district_id = a.district_id AND gender = 'F') AS female_count,
    (SELECT AVG((JULIANDAY('1994-08-25') - JULIANDAY(birth_date)) / 365.25) FROM client WHERE district_id = a.district_id) AS avg_age_years,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE account_id = a.account_id AND date < '1994-08-25') AS num_transactions_before,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM trans WHERE account_id = a.account_id AND date < '1994-08-25' AND type = 'PRIJEM') AS total_income_before
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.date = '1994-08-25';

SELECT
    t.trans_id,
    t.account_id,
    t.date AS trans_date,
    t.type AS trans_type,
    t.operation,
    t.amount,
    t.balance,
    t.k_symbol,
    t.bank,
    t.account,
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    d.district_id,
    d.A2,
    d.A3,
    d.A4,
    d.A5,
    d.A6,
    d.A7,
    d.A8,
    d.A9,
    d.A10,
    d.A11,
    d.A12,
    d.A13,
    d.A14,
    d.A15,
    d.A16,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(l.loan_id || ' (amount:' || l.amount || ', status:' || l.status || ')', '; ')
     FROM loan l
     WHERE l.account_id = t.account_id) AS loans,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(o.order_id || ' (to:' || o.bank_to || ', account:' || o.account_to || ', amount:' || o.amount || ')', '; ')
     FROM `order` o
     WHERE o.account_id = t.account_id) AS orders
FROM
    trans t
JOIN disp dp ON t.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE
    dp.client_id = (
        SELECT dp2.client_id
        FROM card cd
        JOIN disp dp2 ON cd.disp_id = dp2.disp_id
        WHERE cd.issued = '1996-10-21'
        LIMIT 1
    )
ORDER BY
    t.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.gender

JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id IN (
    SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC

SELECT t.amount

WHERE a.account_id = (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND t.date > a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id)
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND client.gender = 'F';

SELECT d.disp_id
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t.date = '1998-09-02' AND t.amount = 5100;

WITH account_litomerice_1996 AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
      AND a.date >= '1996-01-01' AND a.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
account_owner AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date, c.gender, c.birth_date
    FROM account_litomerice_1996 a
    JOIN disp di ON a.account_id = di.account_id AND di.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON di.client_id = c.client_id
),
demographics AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) AS male_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN 1 END) AS female_count,
        AVG( (julianday(a.date) - julianday(birth_date)) / 365.25 ) AS avg_age
    FROM account_owner a
),
txn_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN 1 END) AS total_deposits_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount END), 0) AS total_deposits_amount,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 1 END) AS total_withdrawals_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount END), 0) AS total_withdrawals_amount
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account_litomerice_1996 a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
),
loan_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 END) AS good_loans,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 END) AS bad_loans
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account_litomerice_1996 a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
),
quarter_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 1 END) AS q1_accounts,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 1 END) AS q2_accounts,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 1 END) AS q3_accounts,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN 1 END) AS q4_accounts
    FROM account_litomerice_1996
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_litomerice_1996) AS total_accounts,
    d.male_count,
    d.female_count,
    d.avg_age,
    t.total_transactions,
    t.total_deposits_count,
    t.total_deposits_amount,
    t.total_withdrawals_count,
    t.total_withdrawals_amount,
    l.total_loans,
    l.total_loan_amount,
    l.good_loans,
    l.bad_loans,
    q.q1_accounts,
    q.q2_accounts,
    q.q3_accounts,
    q.q4_accounts
FROM demographics d, txn_stats t, loan_stats l, quarter_stats q;

SELECT
    oa.client_id,
    oa.gender,
    oa.birth_date,
    cd.A2 AS client_district_name,
    cd.A3 AS client_district_region,
    cd.A4 AS client_district_no_inhabitants,
    cd.A5 AS client_district_no_municipalities_lt_499,
    cd.A6 AS client_district_no_municipalities_500_1999,
    cd.A7 AS client_district_no_municipalities_2000_9999,
    cd.A8 AS client_district_no_municipalities_gt_10000,
    cd.A9 AS client_district_no_cities,
    cd.A10 AS client_district_ratio_urban,
    cd.A11 AS client_district_avg_salary,
    cd.A12 AS client_district_unemployment_95,
    cd.A13 AS client_district_unemployment_96,
    cd.A14 AS client_district_no_enterpreneurs,
    cd.A15 AS client_district_no_commited_crimes_95,
    cd.A16 AS client_district_no_commited_crimes_96,
    oa.account_id,
    oa.frequency AS account_frequency,
    oa.account_open_date,
    ad.A2 AS account_district_name,
    ad.A3 AS account_district_region,
    ad.A4 AS account_district_no_inhabitants,
    ad.A5 AS account_district_no_municipalities_lt_499,
    ad.A6 AS account_district_no_municipalities_500_1999,
    ad.A7 AS account_district_no_municipalities_2000_9999,
    ad.A8 AS account_district_no_municipalities_gt_10000,
    ad.A9 AS account_district_no_cities,
    ad.A10 AS account_district_ratio_urban,
    ad.A11 AS account_district_avg_salary,
    ad.A12 AS account_district_unemployment_95,
    ad.A13 AS account_district_unemployment_96,
    ad.A14 AS account_district_no_enterpreneurs,
    ad.A15 AS account_district_no_commited_crimes_95,
    ad.A16 AS account_district_no_commited_crimes_96,
    COALESCE(ts.total_incoming, 0) AS total_incoming_transactions,
    COALESCE(ts.total_outgoing, 0) AS total_outgoing_transactions,
    COALESCE(ts.num_transactions, 0) AS transaction_count,
    ts.last_transaction_date,
    ts.latest_balance,
    COALESCE(ls.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans,
    ls.total_loan_amount,
    ls.avg_loan_payment,
    COALESCE(cs.num_cards, 0) AS num_cards,
    cs.card_types,
    COALESCE(os.num_orders, 0) AS num_orders,
    os.total_order_amount
FROM (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id AS account_district_id,
        a.frequency,
        a.date AS account_open_date,
        cl.client_id,
        cl.district_id AS client_district_id,
        cl.gender,
        cl.birth_date
    FROM client cl
    JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE cl.gender = 'F' AND cl.birth_date = '1976-01-29'
) oa
LEFT JOIN district cd ON oa.client_district_id = cd.district_id
LEFT JOIN district ad ON oa.account_district_id = ad.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_incoming,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_outgoing,
        COUNT(*) AS num_transactions,
        MAX(t.date) AS last_transaction_date,
        (SELECT balance FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.account_id = t.account_id ORDER BY t2.date DESC, t2.trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (
        SELECT a.account_id
        FROM client cl
        JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
        JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
        WHERE cl.gender = 'F' AND cl.birth_date = '1976-01-29'
    )
    GROUP BY t.account_id
) ts ON oa.account_id = ts.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        l.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_loans,
        SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
        AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.account_id IN (
        SELECT a.account_id
        FROM client cl
        JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
        JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
        WHERE cl.gender = 'F' AND cl.birth_date = '1976-01-29'
    )
    GROUP BY l.account_id
) ls ON oa.account_id = ls.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        d.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_cards,
        GROUP_CONCAT(c.type) AS card_types
    FROM disp d
    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE d.account_id IN (
        SELECT a.account_id
        FROM client cl
        JOIN disp d0 ON cl.client_id = d0.client_id AND d0.type = 'OWNER'
        JOIN account a ON d0.account_id = a.account_id
        WHERE cl.gender = 'F' AND cl.birth_date = '1976-01-29'
    )
    GROUP BY d.account_id
) cs ON oa.account_id = cs.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        o.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_orders,
        SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_amount
    FROM "order" o
    WHERE o.account_id IN (
        SELECT a.account_id
        FROM client cl
        JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
        JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
        WHERE cl.gender = 'F' AND cl.birth_date = '1976-01-29'
    )
    GROUP BY o.account_id
) os ON oa.account_id = os.account_id;

SELECT c.birth_date AS birthday,
       CAST((julianday('1996-01-03') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age_at_loan,
       d.A2 AS district_name,
       d.A3 AS region,
       COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) AS total_income_before_loan,
       COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense_before_loan,
       t.trans_count AS transactions_count,
       t.trans_detail AS transaction_history,
       CASE WHEN t.total_income > 0 THEN (t.total_expense * 100.0 / t.total_income) ELSE NULL END AS expense_to_income_ratio,
       t.min_balance,
       t.max_balance,
       COALESCE(cr.card_count, 0) AS credit_card_count,
       cr.card_types,
       cr.latest_card_issued,
       COALESCE(pl.prev_loan_count, 0) AS previous_loans_count
FROM (
    SELECT dp.client_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN disp dp ON l.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    WHERE l.date = '1996-01-03' AND l.amount = 98832
    LIMIT 1
) target
JOIN client c ON target.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
           COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
           MIN(balance) AS min_balance,
           MAX(balance) AS max_balance,
           GROUP_CONCAT(date || ':' || type || ':' || amount, ', ') AS trans_detail
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE date = '1996-01-03' AND amount = 98832 LIMIT 1)
      AND date < '1996-01-03'
) t ON 1=1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ca.type, ', ') AS card_types,
           COUNT(ca.card_id) AS card_count,
           MAX(ca.issued) AS latest_card_issued
    FROM disp dp
    JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
    WHERE dp.client_id = (SELECT client_id FROM disp JOIN loan ON disp.account_id = loan.account_id WHERE loan.date = '1996-01-03' AND loan.amount = 98832 AND disp.type = 'OWNER' LIMIT 1)
) cr ON 1=1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS prev_loan_count
    FROM disp dp
    JOIN loan ln ON dp.account_id = ln.account_id
    WHERE dp.client_id = (SELECT client_id FROM disp JOIN loan ON disp.account_id = loan.account_id WHERE loan.date = '1996-01-03' AND loan.amount = 98832 AND disp.type = 'OWNER' LIMIT 1)
      AND ln.date < '1996-01-03'
) pl ON 1=1;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
       CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
       COUNT(c.client_id) AS total_clients,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_clients,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(c.client_id) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(c.client_id), 2) ELSE 0 END AS male_percentage
FROM district d
LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE d.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE LOWER(A3) = 'south bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY d.district_id;

SELECT ((balance_A.balance_19981227 - balance_B.balance_19930322) * 100.0 / balance_B.balance_19930322) AS increase_rate
FROM (
    SELECT balance AS balance_19930322
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (
        SELECT account_id
        FROM (
            SELECT account_id
            FROM loan
            WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
            ORDER BY loan_id
            LIMIT 1
        )
    )
      AND date <= '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY date DESC, trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS balance_B,
(
    SELECT balance AS balance_19981227
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (
        SELECT account_id
        FROM (
            SELECT account_id
            FROM loan
            WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
            ORDER BY loan_id
            LIMIT 1
        )
    )
      AND date <= '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY date DESC, trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS balance_A;

SELECT d.A3 AS region,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount END), 0) * 100.0 / COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) END AS pct_amount_successful,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(l.loan_id) END AS pct_loans_successful,
       AVG(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN (l.payments * l.duration - l.amount) END) AS avg_interest_successful,
       AVG(l.payments * l.duration - l.amount) AS avg_interest_all
FROM district d
LEFT JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3;

SELECT 
    region,
    size_category,
    ROUND(c_loans * 100.0 / total_loans, 2) AS percentage,
    ROUND(
        SUM(c_loans) OVER (PARTITION BY size_category) * 100.0 
        / SUM(total_loans) OVER (PARTITION BY size_category), 2
    ) AS overall_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        d.A3 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount >= 50000 AND l.amount < 100000 THEN 'Medium'
        END AS size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_loans
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY d.A3, size_category
) grouped
ORDER BY size_category, region

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    d.A10 AS urban_ratio,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_transactions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS poplatek_count,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT l.status) AS loan_statuses,
    CASE
        WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'High Risk'
        WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Medium Risk'
        ELSE 'Low Risk'
    END AS risk_assessment
FROM account a
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM trans
    WHERE k_symbol = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
) h ON a.account_id = h.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
LEFT JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
GROUP BY a.account_id;

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE dist.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31'

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency,
    a.date AS account_open_date,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_credits,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_debits,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END), 0) AS net_balance,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) > 0 AND COUNT(t.trans_id) > 10 THEN 'High Activity'
        WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) > 0 THEN 'Loan Customer'
        WHEN COUNT(t.trans_id) > 10 THEN 'Active Customer'
        ELSE 'Regular Customer'
    END AS customer_category
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id AND d.A2 = 'Prachatice'
LEFT JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
LEFT JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency, a.date, c.gender, c.birth_date
ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT
    loan_id,
    amount,
    duration,
    payments,
    status_description,
    gender,
    birth_date,
    district_name,
    region,
    avg_salary,
    unemployment_rate_95,
    rank_by_amount
FROM (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.amount,
        l.duration,
        l.payments,
        CASE l.status
            WHEN 'A' THEN 'Running - OK'
            WHEN 'B' THEN 'Running - Issues'
            WHEN 'C' THEN 'Finished - No Issues'
            WHEN 'D' THEN 'Finished - Issues'
        END AS status_description,
        c.gender,
        c.birth_date,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS region,
        d.A11 AS avg_salary,
        d.A12 AS unemployment_rate_95,
        d.district_id,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY l.amount DESC) AS rank_by_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER'
) sub
WHERE loan_id = 4990;

SELECT
    qa.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    qa.max_loan_amount,
    qa.loan_count,
    qa.total_loan_amount,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    COALESCE(ts.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS net_income,
    CASE
        WHEN ts.total_income IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE (ts.total_income - ts.total_expense) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ts.total_income, 0)
    END AS savings_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) > 1000000 THEN 'High Income'
        WHEN COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) > 500000 THEN 'Medium Income'
        ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_classification,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3 ORDER BY qa.max_loan_amount DESC) AS rank_in_region
FROM (
    SELECT
        al.account_id,
        al.district_id,
        al.max_loan_amount,
        al.loan_count,
        al.total_loan_amount
    FROM (
        SELECT
            a.account_id,
            a.district_id,
            MAX(l.amount) AS max_loan_amount,
            COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
            SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount
        FROM account a
        JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
        GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id
        HAVING MAX(l.amount) > 300000
    ) al
    JOIN district d ON al.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A11 > (SELECT AVG(A11) FROM district)
) qa
JOIN district d ON qa.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp od ON qa.account_id = od.account_id AND od.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON od.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
        COUNT(trans_id) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
) ts ON qa.account_id = ts.account_id
WHERE ts.total_income IS NULL
   OR (ts.total_income - ts.total_expense) > 0
ORDER BY qa.max_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT district_name, average_salary, loan_id, loan_amount, duration, payments, status, loan_date,
       interest_rate, client_gender, client_birth_date, trans_count, total_trans_amount, last_trans_date
FROM (
    SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
           d.A11 AS average_salary,
           l.loan_id,
           l.amount AS loan_amount,
           l.duration,
           l.payments,
           l.status,
           l.date AS loan_date,
           ROUND((l.payments - l.amount) * 100.0 / l.amount, 2) AS interest_rate,
           c.gender AS client_gender,
           c.birth_date AS client_birth_date,
           COALESCE(t.trans_count, 0) AS trans_count,
           COALESCE(t.total_trans_amount, 0) AS total_trans_amount,
           t.last_trans_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_id ORDER BY l.amount DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN disp dsp ON a.account_id = dsp.account_id AND dsp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON dsp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT account_id,
               COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
               SUM(amount) AS total_trans_amount,
               MAX(date) AS last_trans_date
        FROM trans
        GROUP BY account_id
    ) t ON l.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 60
) sub
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY average_salary DESC, loan_amount DESC

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, ((d.A13 - d.A12) * 100.0 / d.A12) AS unemployment_increment_pct
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT 
    m.month,
    (m.decin_accounts * 100.0 / m.total_accounts) AS decin_percentage,
    m.avg_transaction_amount,
    CASE 
        WHEN (m.decin_accounts * 100.0 / m.total_accounts) > y.overall_percent THEN 'above'
        WHEN (m.decin_accounts * 100.0 / m.total_accounts) < y.overall_percent THEN 'below'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS comparison
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ma.month,
        ma.total_accounts,
        ma.decin_accounts,
        AVG(aat.avg_txn_amount) AS avg_transaction_amount
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            CAST(strftime('%m', a.date) AS INTEGER) AS month,
            COUNT(*) AS total_accounts,
            SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS decin_accounts
        FROM account a
        JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
        WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
        GROUP BY month
    ) ma
    JOIN (
        SELECT a.account_id, strftime('%m', a.date) AS month
        FROM account a
        WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
    ) a ON ma.month = a.month
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            a.account_id,
            AVG(t.amount) AS avg_txn_amount
        FROM account a
        LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
        WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
        GROUP BY a.account_id
    ) aat ON a.account_id = aat.account_id
    GROUP BY ma.month
) m
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) * 100 AS overall_percent
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
) y
ORDER BY m.month

SELECT ma.account_id,
       cd.client_id,
       cd.gender,
       cd.birth_date,
       cd.district_name,
       cd.region,
       COALESCE(ta.total_transactions, 0) AS total_transactions,
       COALESCE(ta.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(ta.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       COALESCE(ta.net_cash_flow, 0) AS net_cash_flow,
       COALESCE(la.active_loan_count, 0) AS active_loan_count,
       COALESCE(la.total_active_loan_amount, 0) AS total_active_loan_amount,
       COALESCE(la.completed_loan_count, 0) AS completed_loan_count,
       COALESCE(la.total_completed_loan_amount, 0) AS total_completed_loan_amount,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ta.total_transactions, 0) DESC) AS transaction_volume_rank,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ta.net_cash_flow, 0) DESC) AS cash_flow_rank
FROM (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM account
    WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
) ma
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT d.account_id,
           c.client_id,
           c.gender,
           c.birth_date,
           dis.A2 AS district_name,
           dis.A3 AS region
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN district dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
) cd ON ma.account_id = cd.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_cash_flow
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
    GROUP BY t.account_id
) ta ON ma.account_id = ta.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT l.account_id,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 END) AS active_loan_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_active_loan_amount,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 END) AS completed_loan_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_completed_loan_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
    GROUP BY l.account_id
) la ON ma.account_id = la.account_id
ORDER BY ma.account_id;
