WITH qualified_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND t.balance < 0
),
trans_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_negative_balance,
        MAX(t.amount) AS max_withdrawal_amount
    FROM trans t
    JOIN qualified_accounts qa ON t.account_id = qa.account_id
    WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND t.balance < 0
),
card_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_cards,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 'gold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_gold_cards
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN qualified_accounts qa ON d.account_id = qa.account_id
),
account_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM qualified_accounts
),
owner_info AS (
    SELECT 
        cl.gender,
        (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2000-01-01') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', cl.birth_date) AS INTEGER) 
         - (strftime('%m-%d', cl.birth_date) > '01-01')) AS age
    FROM qualified_accounts qa
    JOIN disp d ON qa.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_negative_balance FROM trans_stats) AS avg_negative_balance,
    (SELECT max_withdrawal_amount FROM trans_stats) AS max_withdrawal_amount,
    (SELECT total_cards * 1.0 / cnt FROM card_stats, account_count) AS avg_cards_per_account,
    (SELECT total_gold_cards FROM card_stats) AS total_gold_cards,
    (SELECT AVG(age) FROM owner_info) AS avg_owner_age,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM owner_info WHERE gender = 'M') AS male_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM owner_info WHERE gender = 'F') AS female_count

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND loan.amount >= 250000
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND loan.status = 'A';

WITH target_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE c.district_id = 1
      AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')
),
client_remaining_debt AS (
    SELECT t.client_id, SUM(l.amount - (l.payments * l.duration)) AS total_debt
    FROM target_clients t
    JOIN disp d ON t.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')
    GROUP BY t.client_id
),
client_gender AS (
    SELECT client_id, gender
    FROM client
    WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM target_clients)
),
client_age AS (
    SELECT client_id, 
           CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
    FROM client
    WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM target_clients)
),
client_cards AS (
    SELECT t.client_id, COUNT(card.card_id) AS num_cards
    FROM target_clients t
    JOIN disp d ON t.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    LEFT JOIN card ON d.disp_id = card.disp_id
    GROUP BY t.client_id
),
client_transactions AS (
    SELECT t.client_id, COUNT(tr.trans_id) AS num_trans
    FROM target_clients t
    JOIN disp d ON t.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    LEFT JOIN trans tr ON d.account_id = tr.account_id
    GROUP BY t.client_id
),
account_latest_balance AS (
    SELECT tr.account_id, tr.balance
    FROM trans tr
    JOIN (
        SELECT account_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM trans
        GROUP BY account_id
    ) latest ON tr.account_id = latest.account_id AND tr.date = latest.max_date
),
client_balances AS (
    SELECT t.client_id, COALESCE(SUM(alb.balance), 0) AS total_balance
    FROM target_clients t
    JOIN disp d ON t.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    LEFT JOIN account_latest_balance alb ON d.account_id = alb.account_id
    GROUP BY t.client_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(crd.total_debt) AS avg_remaining_debt,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cg.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) AS male_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cg.gender = 'F' THEN 1 END) AS female_count,
    AVG(ca.age) AS avg_age,
    AVG(cc.num_cards) AS avg_cards_per_client,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN cc.num_cards > 0 THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS card_ownership_rate,
    AVG(ct.num_trans) AS avg_transactions_per_client,
    AVG(cb.total_balance) AS avg_total_balance_per_client
FROM target_clients t
JOIN client_remaining_debt crd ON t.client_id = crd.client_id
JOIN client_gender cg ON t.client_id = cg.client_id
JOIN client_age ca ON t.client_id = ca.client_id
JOIN client_cards cc ON t.client_id = cc.client_id
JOIN client_transactions ct ON t.client_id = ct.client_id
JOIN client_balances cb ON t.client_id = cb.client_id;

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client WHERE gender = 'M' AND district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A15 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY A15 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)) AS total_male_clients,
    (SELECT A15 FROM district WHERE A15 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY A15 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) AS crime_count_1995,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
     FROM disp d
     JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
     JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
     WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND c.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A15 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY A15 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)) AS total_accounts,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id)
     FROM loan l
     JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
     JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
     WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND c.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A15 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY A15 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)) AS total_loans,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id)
     FROM card ca
     JOIN disp d ON ca.disp_id = d.disp_id
     JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
     WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND c.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A15 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY A15 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) AND ca.type = 'credit') AS total_credit_cards,
    (SELECT CAST(COUNT(d.disp_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
     FROM disp d
     JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
     WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND c.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A15 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY A15 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)) AS avg_dispositions_per_client,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
     FROM loan l
     JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
     JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
     WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND c.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A15 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY A15 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)) AS clients_with_loans,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client
     WHERE gender = 'M' AND district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A15 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY A15 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)
       AND (julianday('now') - julianday(birth_date)) / 365.25 < 30) AS young_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client
     WHERE gender = 'M' AND district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A15 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY A15 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)
       AND (julianday('now') - julianday(birth_date)) / 365.25 >= 30
       AND (julianday('now') - julianday(birth_date)) / 365.25 < 50) AS middle_age_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client
     WHERE gender = 'M' AND district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A15 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY A15 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)
       AND (julianday('now') - julianday(birth_date)) / 365.25 >= 50) AS senior_count;

SELECT
    cl.gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) AS num_clients,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts,
    AVG(a.avg_balance) AS avg_account_balance,
    AVG((julianday('now') - julianday(cl.birth_date)) / 365.25) AS avg_age
FROM (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
    HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000
) a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id AND c.type = 'gold'
JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
GROUP BY cl.gender;

WITH pisek_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek'
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pisek_accounts) AS total_accounts,
    (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pisek_accounts) ELSE 0 END
     FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts)) AS avg_transactions_per_account,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts) AND type = 'PRIJEM') AS total_deposits,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts) AND type = 'VYDAJ') AS total_withdrawals,
    (SELECT AVG(max_balance) FROM (
         SELECT COALESCE(MAX(t.balance), 0) AS max_balance
         FROM pisek_accounts a
         LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
         GROUP BY a.account_id
     ) sub) AS avg_max_balance,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id)
     FROM card c
     JOIN disp dsp ON c.disp_id = dsp.disp_id
     WHERE dsp.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts)
       AND c.type = 'credit') AS total_credit_cards,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts)) AS total_loans,
    (SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(amount) = 0 THEN 0
                 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount)
            END
     FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts)) AS percentage_active_loan_amounts,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) FROM disp
     WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts) AND type = 'OWNER') AS unique_account_owners;

SELECT DISTINCT d.*
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000 AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1997';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN `order` o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek' AND o.k_symbol = 'SIPO';

SELECT a.account_id,
       d.A2 AS district_name,
       d.A3 AS region,
       d.A4 AS inhabitants,
       d.A5 AS municipalities_lt_499,
       d.A6 AS municipalities_500_1999,
       d.A7 AS municipalities_2000_9999,
       d.A8 AS municipalities_ge_10000,
       d.A9 AS cities,
       d.A10 AS urban_ratio,
       d.A11 AS avg_salary,
       d.A12 AS unemployment_95,
       d.A13 AS unemployment_96,
       d.A14 AS entrepreneurs_per_1000,
       d.A15 AS crimes_95,
       d.A16 AS crimes_96,
       gc.gold_card_count,
       COALESCE(t.trans_count, 0) AS total_transactions,
       COALESCE(t.income_count, 0) AS income_transactions,
       COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(t.expense_count, 0) AS expense_transactions,
       COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       t.avg_balance,
       t.min_balance,
       t.max_balance,
       COALESCE(l.good_loan_count, 0) AS good_loan_count,
       COALESCE(l.total_good_amount, 0) AS total_good_loan_amount,
       COALESCE(l.bad_loan_count, 0) AS bad_loan_count,
       COALESCE(l.total_bad_amount, 0) AS total_bad_loan_amount,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.avg_balance DESC) AS balance_rank
FROM account a
JOIN (
    SELECT dsp.account_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp dsp ON c.disp_id = dsp.disp_id
    WHERE LOWER(c.type) = 'gold'
    GROUP BY dsp.account_id
) gold_acc ON a.account_id = gold_acc.account_id
JOIN disp owner_disp ON a.account_id = owner_disp.account_id AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client cl ON owner_disp.client_id = cl.client_id
JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT dsp.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS gold_card_count
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp dsp ON c.disp_id = dsp.disp_id
    WHERE LOWER(c.type) = 'gold'
    GROUP BY dsp.account_id
) gc ON a.account_id = gc.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN 1 END) AS income_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 1 END) AS expense_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
           AVG(balance) AS avg_balance,
           MIN(balance) AS min_balance,
           MAX(balance) AS max_balance
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
) t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 END) AS good_loan_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_good_amount,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 END) AS bad_loan_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_bad_amount
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
) l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
ORDER BY balance_rank;

SELECT
    d.A3 AS region,
    d.A2 AS district,
    c.gender,
    ca.type AS card_type,
    COUNT(*) AS num_transactions,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_spending,
    AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount,
    d.A11 AS district_avg_salary,
    SUM(t.amount) * 1.0 / d.A11 AS total_spending_to_salary_ratio,
    AVG(t.amount) * 1.0 / d.A11 AS avg_txn_to_salary_ratio
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
GROUP BY d.A3, d.A2, c.gender, ca.type

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
  AND t.amount < (
      SELECT AVG(t2.amount)
      FROM trans t2
      WHERE t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
        AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) = '1998'
  );

SELECT foa.account_id, foa.client_id, foa.district_id,
       al.total_loan,
       ac.card_details,
       al.loan_statuses,
       COALESCE(at.trans_count, 0) AS trans_count,
       COALESCE(at.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(at.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       ROUND(COALESCE(at.avg_trans_amount, 0), 2) AS avg_trans_amount,
       CASE WHEN at.total_income IS NULL OR at.total_income = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((at.total_income - at.total_expense) * 100.0 / at.total_income, 2)
       END AS savings_rate,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY foa.district_id ORDER BY al.total_loan DESC) AS region_loan_rank
FROM (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, c.client_id, d.disp_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.birth_date <= DATE('now', '-18 years')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card cd WHERE cd.disp_id = d.disp_id)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id)
) foa
JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           SUM(amount) AS total_loan,
           GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE status WHEN 'A' THEN 'Good Standing' WHEN 'B' THEN 'Default' ELSE status END) AS loan_statuses
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
) al ON foa.account_id = al.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
           AVG(amount) AS avg_trans_amount
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
) at ON foa.account_id = at.account_id
JOIN (
    SELECT d.account_id, GROUP_CONCAT(cd.type || ' (' || cd.issued || ')', ', ') AS card_details
    FROM disp d
    JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
    GROUP BY d.account_id
) ac ON foa.account_id = ac.account_id
ORDER BY al.total_loan DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
    cs.district_id,
    cs.A2 AS district_name,
    cs.age_group,
    COUNT(*) AS num_clients,
    AVG(cs.total_trans_count) AS avg_trans_activity,
    AVG(cs.avg_trans_amount_per_client) AS avg_trans_amount,
    AVG(cs.net_balance) AS avg_net_balance,
    AVG(CASE WHEN cs.total_loan_amount > 0 THEN cs.total_loan_amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_loan_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cs.total_loan_amount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS active_loan_rate
FROM (
    SELECT 
        oa.client_id,
        oa.district_id,
        oa.A2,
        oa.age_group,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.total_income), 0) AS total_income,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.total_expense), 0) AS total_expense,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.trans_count), 0) AS total_trans_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.avg_trans_amount * t.trans_count), 0) AS total_trans_amount,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(t.trans_count), 0) > 0 
             THEN COALESCE(SUM(t.avg_trans_amount * t.trans_count), 0) * 1.0 / SUM(t.trans_count) 
             ELSE NULL END AS avg_trans_amount_per_client,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.total_income), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(t.total_expense), 0) AS net_balance,
        COALESCE(SUM(l.total_loan_amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
        MAX(l.has_active_loan) AS has_active_loan
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            ag.client_id, 
            ag.district_id, 
            ag.A2, 
            ag.age_group, 
            dsp.account_id
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                c.client_id,
                c.birth_date,
                c.district_id,
                d.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) > 1980 THEN 'Young'
                    WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1960 AND 1980 THEN 'Middle-aged'
                    ELSE 'Senior'
                END AS age_group
            FROM client c
            JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
            WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
        ) ag
        JOIN disp dsp ON ag.client_id = dsp.client_id AND dsp.type = 'OWNER'
    ) oa
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            account_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
            SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
            COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
            AVG(amount) AS avg_trans_amount
        FROM trans
        GROUP BY account_id
    ) t ON oa.account_id = t.account_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            account_id,
            SUM(amount) AS total_loan_amount,
            MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_active_loan
        FROM loan
        GROUP BY account_id
    ) l ON oa.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY oa.client_id, oa.district_id, oa.A2, oa.age_group
) cs
GROUP BY cs.district_id, cs.A2, cs.age_group
ORDER BY cs.district_id, cs.age_group;

SELECT
    client_id,
    gender,
    CAST((strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', birth_date)) AS INTEGER) AS age,
    transaction_count,
    total_transaction_amount,
    avg_transaction_amount,
    avg_balance,
    loan_count,
    total_loan_amount,
    avg_loan_amount,
    CASE WHEN bad_loan_count > 0 THEN 'Bad' ELSE 'Good' END AS credit_status,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_balance DESC, age DESC) AS priority_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.client_id,
        c.gender,
        c.birth_date,
        COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_transaction_amount,
        COALESCE(AVG(t.amount), 0) AS avg_transaction_amount,
        COALESCE(AVG(t.balance), 0) AS avg_balance,
        COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
        COALESCE(AVG(l.amount), 0) AS avg_loan_amount,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bad_loan_count
    FROM client c
    JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id AND dist.A2 = 'Tabor'
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
)
ORDER BY priority_rank

SELECT DISTINCT d.type, dt.A11
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE d.type != 'OWNER'
  AND dt.A11 > 8000 AND dt.A11 <= 9000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
       COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_withdrawals,
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal_amount,
       CAST(d.A4 AS REAL) AS population,
       CASE WHEN CAST(d.A4 AS REAL) > 0 
            THEN ROUND(SUM(t.amount) * 1.0 / CAST(d.A4 AS REAL), 2) 
            ELSE 0 
       END AS withdrawal_per_capita,
       CAST(d.A12 AS REAL) AS unemployment_rate_95,
       CASE 
           WHEN CAST(d.A12 AS REAL) > 2.0 THEN 'High'
           WHEN CAST(d.A12 AS REAL) >= 1.0 THEN 'Medium'
           ELSE 'Low'
       END AS unemployment_category,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS withdrawal_rank
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
GROUP BY d.district_id
ORDER BY total_withdrawal_amount DESC;

SELECT AVG(d.A15)
FROM district d
WHERE d.A15 > 4000
  AND d.district_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM account a
    WHERE a.date >= '1997-01-01'
  );

SELECT d.district_id,
       d.A2 AS district_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS classic_cardholders_count,
       AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount,
       AVG(ab.balance) AS avg_account_balance,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 END) AS good_loan_count,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 END) AS bad_loan_count,
       d.A11 AS district_average_salary,
       d.A12 AS unemployment_rate
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id AND card.type = 'classic'
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) -
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'debit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS balance
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
) ab ON a.account_id = ab.account_id
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, d.A11, d.A12
ORDER BY d.district_id;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN a.age < 30 THEN 'Young'
        WHEN a.age <= 50 THEN 'Middle-aged'
        ELSE 'Senior'
    END AS age_group,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_clients,
    COUNT(DISTINCT da.account_id) AS num_accounts,
    ROUND(AVG(ab.balance), 2) AS avg_balance,
    COALESCE(SUM(ti.total_income), 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(SUM(te.total_expense), 0) AS total_expense,
    COALESCE(SUM(la.total_loan_amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(la.num_loans), 0) AS total_loans,
    COALESCE(SUM(la.num_good_loans), 0) AS good_loans,
    COALESCE(SUM(la.num_bad_loans), 0) AS bad_loans
FROM (
    SELECT
        client_id,
        (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', birth_date)) - 
        (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', birth_date)) AS age
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'M'
      AND district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A3 = 'Prague')
) a
JOIN client c ON a.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT client_id, account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE type = 'OWNER'
) da ON c.client_id = da.client_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE trans_id IN (
        SELECT MAX(trans_id)
        FROM trans
        GROUP BY account_id
    )
) ab ON da.account_id = ab.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_income
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'PRIJEM'
    GROUP BY account_id
) ti ON da.account_id = ti.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_expense
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY account_id
) te ON da.account_id = te.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS num_loans,
           SUM(amount) AS total_loan_amount,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_good_loans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_bad_loans
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
) la ON da.account_id = la.account_id
GROUP BY age_group
ORDER BY CASE age_group WHEN 'Young' THEN 1 WHEN 'Middle-aged' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

SELECT region, ROUND(100.0 * pre1998_count / total_count, 2) AS percentage
FROM (
  SELECT dist.A3 AS region,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN c.issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 END) AS pre1998_count,
         COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
  JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
  JOIN district dist ON cl.district_id = dist.district_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold'
  GROUP BY dist.A3
) AS region_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Overall', ROUND(100.0 * SUM(pre1998_count) / SUM(total_count), 2)
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN c.issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 END) AS pre1998_count,
         COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM card c
  WHERE c.type = 'gold'
);

WITH max_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id, amount AS loan_amount
    FROM loan
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
owner AS (
    SELECT d.client_id, d.account_id, ml.loan_amount
    FROM disp d
    JOIN max_loan ml ON d.account_id = ml.account_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    CASE
        WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 < 30 THEN 'Young'
        WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN 'Middle-aged'
        ELSE 'Senior'
    END AS age_category,
    o.loan_amount AS largest_loan_amount,
    dist.A13 AS unemployment_rate,
    CASE WHEN dist.A13 > 1.0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS high_unemployment_area,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)
    END AS savings_rate,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_transactions,
    MAX(t.date) AS latest_transaction_date
FROM owner o
JOIN client c ON o.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id
LEFT JOIN trans t ON o.account_id = t.account_id
GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, o.loan_amount, dist.A13;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.district_id,
    d.A15 AS crimes_1995,
    d.A16 AS crimes_1996,
    ROUND(ds.pct_change, 2) AS pct_change,
    ds.pct_rank,
    ROUND(ds.avg_A16, 2) AS avg_crimes_1996,
    COALESCE(l.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans,
    COALESCE(t.num_transactions, 0) AS num_transactions
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        district_id,
        A15,
        A16,
        CASE WHEN A15 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (A16 - A15) * 100.0 / A15 END AS pct_change,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (A16 - A15) * 100.0 / A15 DESC) AS pct_rank,
        AVG(A16) OVER () AS avg_A16
    FROM district
) ds ON a.district_id = ds.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(loan_id) AS num_loans
    FROM loan
    WHERE account_id = 532
    GROUP BY account_id
) l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(trans_id) AS num_transactions
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = 532
    GROUP BY account_id
) t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = 532;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A11 AS avg_salary,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.A11 DESC) AS salary_rank,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.client_id || '(' || c.gender || ',' || c.birth_date || ',' || dp.type || ')') 
     FROM disp dp JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id WHERE dp.account_id = a.account_id) AS owners,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.trans_id || ':' || t.date || ':' || t.type || ':' || t.amount || ':' || t.balance) 
     FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id ORDER BY t.date) AS transaction_history,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(l.loan_id || ':' || l.amount || ':' || l.status || ':' || l.payments) 
     FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id) AS loan_info,
    o.order_id,
    o.bank_to,
    o.account_to,
    o.amount AS order_amount,
    o.k_symbol
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.order_id = 33333;

SELECT t.*
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 3356 AND t.operation = 'VYBER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount < 200000;

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A11 AS average_salary,
    dr.salary_rank,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(ca.type || ' (issued: ' || ca.issued || ')') 
     FROM card ca 
     JOIN disp dp ON ca.disp_id = dp.disp_id 
     WHERE dp.client_id = c.client_id) AS card_details,
    COALESCE(ta.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(ta.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    COALESCE(ta.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(lc.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM card ca 
            JOIN disp dp ON ca.disp_id = dp.disp_id 
            WHERE dp.client_id = c.client_id AND ca.type = 'gold'
        ) THEN 'Premium'
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM card ca 
            JOIN disp dp ON ca.disp_id = dp.disp_id 
            WHERE dp.client_id = c.client_id 
              AND ca.type = 'classic' 
              AND (julianday('now') - julianday(ca.issued)) > 5 * 365
        ) THEN 'Long-term Classic'
        ELSE 'Standard'
    END AS customer_segment
FROM client c
LEFT JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT district_id, 
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY A11 DESC) AS salary_rank
    FROM district
) dr ON c.district_id = dr.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = 13539)
) ta ON 1=1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan
    WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = 13539)
) lc ON 1=1
WHERE c.client_id = 13539

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.date AS account_opened,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT l.status) AS loan_statuses,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_transactions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_balance,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FROM client c WHERE c.district_id = a.district_id AND c.client_id != 3541) AS other_clients_in_region
FROM account a
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.client_id = 3541
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
GROUP BY a.account_id, a.date, a.district_id, d.A2, d.A3
ORDER BY total_transactions DESC

SELECT d.A2
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    "order".order_id,
    "order".account_id,
    "order".bank_to,
    "order".account_to,
    "order".amount AS order_amount,
    "order".k_symbol,
    client.gender,
    client.birth_date,
    district.A2 AS district_name,
    district.A3 AS region,

    district.A10 AS avg_salary,
    district.A11 AS unemployment_rate_95,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(loan.status, ', ') FROM loan WHERE loan.account_id = "order".account_id) AS loan_statuses,
    (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN trans.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM trans WHERE trans.account_id = "order".account_id) AS total_income,
    (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN trans.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM trans WHERE trans.account_id = "order".account_id) AS total_expense,
    (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN trans.amount WHEN trans.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -trans.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM trans WHERE trans.account_id = "order".account_id) AS net_balance,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card JOIN disp AS d2 ON card.disp_id = d2.disp_id WHERE d2.account_id = "order".account_id AND d2.type = 'OWNER') AS num_credit_cards
FROM "order"

JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id

WHERE "order".order_id = 32423;

SELECT t.*
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 5

WITH jesenik_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Jesenik')
),
transaction_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount END), 0) AS total_prijem_amount,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount END), 0) AS total_vydaj_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM jesenik_accounts)
),
loan_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS good_loans,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bad_loans
    FROM loan
    WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM jesenik_accounts)
),
latest_balance AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN (
        SELECT account_id, MAX(trans_id) AS max_trans_id
        FROM trans
        WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM jesenik_accounts)
        GROUP BY account_id
    ) lb ON t.trans_id = lb.max_trans_id
),
gender_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM jesenik_accounts)
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jesenik_accounts) AS total_accounts,
    COALESCE((SELECT total_transactions FROM transaction_stats), 0) AS total_transactions,
    COALESCE((SELECT total_prijem_amount FROM transaction_stats), 0) AS total_prijem_amount,
    COALESCE((SELECT total_vydaj_amount FROM transaction_stats), 0) AS total_vydaj_amount,
    COALESCE((SELECT total_loans FROM loan_stats), 0) AS total_loans,
    COALESCE((SELECT good_loans FROM loan_stats), 0) AS good_loans,
    COALESCE((SELECT bad_loans FROM loan_stats), 0) AS bad_loans,
    COALESCE((SELECT AVG(balance) FROM latest_balance), 0) AS avg_balance,
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gender_clients WHERE gender = 'M'), 0) AS male_clients,
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gender_clients WHERE gender = 'F'), 0) AS female_clients;

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'junior' AND cd.issued >= '1997-01-01';

SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage_women
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district dis ON a.district_id = dis.district_id
    WHERE dis.A11 > 10000
) AS eligible_clients
JOIN client c ON eligible_clients.client_id = c.client_id;

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) 
     - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE d.account_id = a.account_id
      AND c.gender = 'M'
)
AND strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND date > '1995-12-31';
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'east Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS difference FROM district;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           d.A3 AS region,
           d.A2 AS district_name,
           d.A11 AS district_salary
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
),
total_accounts AS (
    SELECT region,
           district_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS num_accounts,
           AVG(district_salary) AS avg_district_salary
    FROM base
    GROUP BY region, district_name
),
loan_stats AS (
    SELECT b.region,
           b.district_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.loan_id IS NOT NULL THEN b.account_id END) AS accounts_with_loan,
           AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
    FROM base b
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON b.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY b.region, b.district_name
),
transaction_stats AS (
    SELECT b.region,
           b.district_name,
           COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_transactions
    FROM base b
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON b.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY b.region, b.district_name
),
latest_balance AS (
    SELECT b.region,
           b.district_name,
           t.balance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.account_id ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC) AS rn
    FROM base b
    JOIN trans t ON b.account_id = t.account_id
),
balance_stats AS (
    SELECT region,
           district_name,
           AVG(balance) AS avg_account_balance
    FROM latest_balance
    WHERE rn = 1
    GROUP BY region, district_name
)
SELECT ta.region,
       ta.district_name,
       ta.num_accounts,
       ta.avg_district_salary,
       CAST(ls.accounts_with_loan AS REAL) / ta.num_accounts AS loan_adoption_rate,
       ls.avg_loan_amount,
       ts.total_transactions AS transaction_activity,
       bs.avg_account_balance
FROM total_accounts ta
JOIN loan_stats ls ON ta.region = ls.region AND ta.district_name = ls.district_name
JOIN transaction_stats ts ON ta.region = ts.region AND ta.district_name = ts.district_name
JOIN balance_stats bs ON ta.region = bs.region AND ta.district_name = bs.district_name
ORDER BY ta.region, ta.district_name;

SELECT t.loan_id,
       t.amount AS loan_amount,
       t.duration,
       t.payments AS monthly_payment,
       t.total_payments,
       t.interest_paid,
       t.status AS loan_status,
       d.A2 AS location,
       COALESCE(tr.transaction_activity, 0) AS transaction_activity,
       CASE
           WHEN d.A11 > 2 * t.amount THEN 'High'
           WHEN d.A11 > t.amount THEN 'Medium'
           ELSE 'Low'
       END AS income_category,
       CAST((julianday(date('now')) - julianday(t.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM (

    FROM client c

SELECT y.opening_year,
       COALESCE(d.male_count, 0) AS male_count,
       COALESCE(d.female_count, 0) AS female_count,
       COALESCE(d.total_owners, 0) AS total_owners,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.total_owners, 0) > 0 
            THEN CAST(d.male_count AS REAL) / d.total_owners * 100 
            ELSE NULL END AS male_percentage,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.total_owners, 0) > 0 
            THEN CAST(d.female_count AS REAL) / d.total_owners * 100 
            ELSE NULL END AS female_percentage,
       d.avg_age,
       COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(t.total_expenses, 0) AS total_expenses,
       COALESCE(l.total_loans, 0) AS total_loans,
       COALESCE(l.successful_loans, 0) AS successful_loans,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.total_loans, 0) > 0 
            THEN CAST(l.successful_loans AS REAL) / l.total_loans 
            ELSE NULL END AS loan_success_rate,
       COALESCE(c.classic_cards, 0) AS classic_cards,
       COALESCE(c.junior_cards, 0) AS junior_cards,
       COALESCE(c.gold_cards, 0) AS gold_cards
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) AS opening_year
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun' 
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) > 1996
) y
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT a.opening_year,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) AS male_count,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 END) AS female_count,
           COUNT(*) AS total_owners,
           AVG((julianday(a.account_date) - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25) AS avg_age
    FROM (
        SELECT a.account_id, 
               CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) AS opening_year, 
               a.date AS account_date
        FROM account a
        JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
        WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun' 
          AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) > 1996
    ) a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    GROUP BY a.opening_year
) d ON y.opening_year = d.opening_year
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT a.opening_year,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'debit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expenses
    FROM (
        SELECT a.account_id, 
               CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) AS opening_year
        FROM account a
        JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
        WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun' 
          AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) > 1996
    ) a
    JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY a.opening_year
) t ON y.opening_year = t.opening_year
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT a.opening_year,
           COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('A','C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_loans
    FROM (
        SELECT a.account_id, 
               CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) AS opening_year
        FROM account a
        JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
        WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun' 
          AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) > 1996
    ) a
    JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY a.opening_year
) l ON y.opening_year = l.opening_year
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT a.opening_year,
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 'classic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS classic_cards,
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 'junior' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS junior_cards,
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 'gold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_cards
    FROM (
        SELECT a.account_id, 
               CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) AS opening_year
        FROM account a
        JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
        WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun' 
          AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) > 1996
    ) a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    GROUP BY a.opening_year
) c ON y.opening_year = c.opening_year
ORDER BY y.opening_year;

SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS account_open_date, a.frequency, a.district_id AS account_district_id,

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cte WHERE gender = 'F') AS female_count,
    (SELECT district_id FROM cte GROUP BY district_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS most_common_district,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM disp WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM cte)) AS total_accounts,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM cte))) AS total_loans,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM cte))), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
    COALESCE((SELECT AVG(duration) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM cte))), 0) AS avg_loan_duration,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM cte))) AS total_transactions,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM cte)) AND type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM cte)) AND type = 'VYDAJ'), 0) AS total_expenses,
    COALESCE((SELECT AVG(amount) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM cte))), 0) AS avg_transaction_amount;

WITH top_loans AS (

    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
      AND l.duration = 24
    ORDER BY l.amount DESC

)
SELECT

    AVG(payments * duration - amount) AS avg_total_interest,
    AVG( (payments * duration - amount) * 1.0 / amount / (duration/12.0) * 100 ) AS avg_simple_annual_interest_rate_pct,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_A_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_B_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_C_count,

    AVG(A4) AS avg_district_population,

FROM top_loans;

SELECT 
    tb.bond_type,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS total_occurrences,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS molecules_containing,
    CAST(COUNT(b.bond_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS avg_bonds_per_molecule,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MIN(a1.element, a2.element) || '-' || MAX(a1.element, a2.element))
     FROM connected c
     JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
     JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
     JOIN bond b2 ON c.bond_id = b2.bond_id
     WHERE b2.bond_type = tb.bond_type) AS unique_element_pairs_connected,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.label) AS molecule_labels
FROM (
    SELECT bond_type
    FROM bond
    GROUP BY bond_type
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) tb
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_type = tb.bond_type
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
GROUP BY tb.bond_type;

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS molecule_count,
    AVG(chlorine_count) AS avg_chlorine_count,
    MAX(chlorine_count) AS max_chlorine_count,
    AVG(total_bond_count) AS avg_bond_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN single_bond_count > double_bond_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_more_single_than_double,
    AVG(chlorine_bond_count) AS avg_chlorine_bond_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        cc.chlorine_count,
        COALESCE(bc.total_bond_count, 0) AS total_bond_count,
        COALESCE(bc.single_bond_count, 0) AS single_bond_count,
        COALESCE(bc.double_bond_count, 0) AS double_bond_count,
        COALESCE(cbc.chlorine_bond_count, 0) AS chlorine_bond_count
    FROM (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM molecule
        WHERE label = '-'
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM atom 
              WHERE atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
                AND element = 'cl'
          )
    ) m
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS chlorine_count
        FROM atom
        WHERE element = 'cl'
        GROUP BY molecule_id
    ) cc ON m.molecule_id = cc.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            molecule_id,
            COUNT(*) AS total_bond_count,
            SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bond_count,
            SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS double_bond_count
        FROM bond
        GROUP BY molecule_id
    ) bc ON m.molecule_id = bc.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            b.molecule_id,
            COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS chlorine_bond_count
        FROM bond b
        JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
        JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
        WHERE a.element = 'cl'
        GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ) cbc ON m.molecule_id = cbc.molecule_id
) combined_stats;

SELECT AVG(oxygen_count)
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 1 END) AS oxygen_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.molecule_id IN (
        SELECT b.molecule_id
        FROM bond b
        GROUP BY b.molecule_id
        HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type != '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
           AND COUNT(b.bond_id) > 0
    )
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) t;

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '-') * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+') AS average;

SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND element = 'C') AS carbon_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND element = 'N') AS nitrogen_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND bond_type = '#') AS total_triple_bonds,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id)
     FROM bond b
     JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
     JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
     JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
     WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
       AND b.bond_type = '#'
       AND a1.element = 'N'
       AND a2.element = 'N') AS nn_triple_bonds,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id)
     FROM bond b
     JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
     JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
     JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
     WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
       AND b.bond_type = '#'
       AND (a1.element = 'C' OR a2.element = 'C')) AS carbon_triple_bonds
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND bond_type = '#')
ORDER BY total_triple_bonds, m.molecule_id;

SELECT
    AVG(conn_count) AS avg_connections_per_non_bromine,
    SUM(CASE WHEN conn_count > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_non_bromine_with_gt_2_connections
FROM (
    SELECT
        a.atom_id,
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM connected c
         WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id) AS conn_count
    FROM atom a
    WHERE (a.element IS NULL OR LOWER(a.element) != 'br')
      AND a.molecule_id IN (
          SELECT molecule_id
          FROM molecule
          WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id)
             OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a2 WHERE a2.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id) > 1
      )
);

SELECT AVG(num_atoms) AS avg_atoms,
       AVG(num_carbon_atoms) AS avg_carbon_atoms,
       AVG(num_bonds) AS avg_bonds,
       AVG(num_double_bonds) AS avg_double_bonds,
       AVG(num_connected_atoms) AS avg_connected_atoms,
       AVG(CASE WHEN num_bonds > 0 THEN c_c_bonds * 1.0 / num_bonds END) AS avg_cc_ratio
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE atom.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS num_atoms,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE atom.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND element = 'C') AS num_carbon_atoms,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS num_bonds,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND bond_type = 'double') AS num_double_bonds,
           (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ca.atom_id) FROM (
               SELECT c.atom_id FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
               UNION
               SELECT c.atom_id2 FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
           ) ca) AS num_connected_atoms,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected c
            JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
            JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
            WHERE a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
              AND a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C') AS c_c_bonds
    FROM molecule m
    WHERE m.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099'
      AND m.label = '+'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element IN ('C','H')
      )
) sub;

WITH carbon_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'c'
),
atom_stats AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM carbon_molecules)
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_stats AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS double_bonds
    FROM bond
    WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM carbon_molecules)
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
connection_stats AS (
    SELECT
        b.molecule_id,
        COUNT(c.atom_id) AS total_connections
    FROM bond b
    LEFT JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE b.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM carbon_molecules)
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
)
SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    COALESCE(a.total_atoms, 0) AS total_atoms,
    COALESCE(a.carbon_atoms, 0) AS carbon_atoms,
    COALESCE(a.chlorine_atoms, 0) AS chlorine_atoms,
    COALESCE(b.total_bonds, 0) AS total_bonds,
    COALESCE(b.double_bonds, 0) AS double_bonds,
    COALESCE(c.total_connections, 0) AS total_connections
FROM carbon_molecules cm
JOIN molecule m ON cm.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN atom_stats a ON cm.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bond_stats b ON cm.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN connection_stats c ON cm.molecule_id = c.molecule_id
ORDER BY carbon_atoms DESC, total_atoms DESC;

SELECT a.element,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count_participating_in_double_bonds,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count_containing_them,
       (COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) * 100.0) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom) AS percentage_of_all_atoms,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(label, ', ')
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT m2.label
              FROM atom a2
              JOIN connected c2 ON (a2.atom_id = c2.atom_id OR a2.atom_id = c2.atom_id2)
              JOIN bond b2 ON c2.bond_id = b2.bond_id
              JOIN molecule m2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
              WHERE a2.element = a.element
                AND b2.bond_type = '='
              LIMIT 3)) AS example_molecules
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON (a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2)
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element

SELECT 
    ml.total_h AS total_hydrogen_atoms,
    CAST(ml.total_h AS REAL) / mc.num_molecules AS avg_hydrogen_per_molecule,
    CAST(bc.total_bonds AS REAL) / mc.num_molecules AS avg_bonds_per_molecule,
    bc.total_single AS total_single_bonds,
    bc.total_double AS total_double_bonds
FROM (
    SELECT label, total_h
    FROM (
        SELECT m.label, COUNT(*) AS total_h
        FROM molecule m
        JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
        WHERE a.element = 'h'
        GROUP BY m.label
    ) h_counts
    ORDER BY total_h DESC
    LIMIT 1
) ml
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS num_molecules
    FROM molecule m
    WHERE m.label = (SELECT label FROM (
        SELECT m.label, COUNT(*) AS total_h
        FROM molecule m
        JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
        WHERE a.element = 'h'
        GROUP BY m.label
    ) h_counts
    ORDER BY total_h DESC
    LIMIT 1)
) mc
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(b.bond_id) AS total_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_single,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_double
    FROM bond b
    JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = (SELECT label FROM (
        SELECT m.label, COUNT(*) AS total_h
        FROM molecule m
        JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
        WHERE a.element = 'h'
        GROUP BY m.label
    ) h_counts
    ORDER BY total_h DESC
    LIMIT 1)
) bc

JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id

SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN has_f = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS pct_no_fluorine,
    AVG(atom_count) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
    AVG(CASE WHEN has_f = 1 THEN bond_count END) AS avg_bonds_with_f,
    AVG(CASE WHEN has_f = 0 THEN bond_count END) AS avg_bonds_without_f,
    (SELECT AVG(CASE b.bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END)
     FROM bond b
     INNER JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
     WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=', '#')) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM (
    SELECT
        cm.molecule_id,
        COALESCE(a.atom_count, 0) AS atom_count,
        a.has_f,
        COALESCE(b.bond_count, 0) AS bond_count
    FROM (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM molecule
        WHERE label = '+'
    ) cm
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT molecule_id,
               COUNT(*) AS atom_count,
               MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(element) = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_f
        FROM atom
        GROUP BY molecule_id
    ) a ON cm.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT molecule_id,
               COUNT(*) AS bond_count
        FROM bond
        GROUP BY molecule_id
    ) b ON cm.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
) combined;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'carcinogenic'

SELECT DISTINCT tag
FROM (
  WITH user_posts AS (
    SELECT Tags
    FROM posts
    WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'John Salvatier')
      AND Tags IS NOT NULL AND Tags <> ''
  ),
  split(tag, remaining) AS (
    SELECT '', Tags FROM user_posts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBSTR(remaining, 2, INSTR(remaining, '>') - 2),
           SUBSTR(remaining, INSTR(remaining, '>') + 1)
    FROM split
    WHERE remaining <> ''
  )
  SELECT tag FROM split WHERE tag <> ''
)

SELECT DISTINCT tag
FROM (
    WITH RECURSIVE tag_split(tag, remaining) AS (
        SELECT '', p.Tags || '>' 
        FROM posts p 
        WHERE p.OwnerDisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' 
          AND p.CommentCount = 0 
          AND p.Tags IS NOT NULL 
          AND p.Tags <> ''
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 
            substr(remaining, 2, instr(remaining, '>') - 2),
            substr(remaining, instr(remaining, '>') + 1)
        FROM tag_split
        WHERE remaining <> ''
    )
    SELECT tag
    FROM tag_split
    WHERE tag <> ''
);

SELECT AVG(CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, 1, 2) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, 4, 2) AS REAL) + CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, 7, 3) AS REAL) / 1000) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds
FROM results r

AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL AND r.fastestLapTime != ''

WITH race_id AS (
    SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2008 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
champ AS (
    SELECT time AS champ_time
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_id) AND position = 1 AND time IS NOT NULL
),
last AS (
    SELECT time AS gap_time
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_id) AND time IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY position DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
champ_parse AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(champ_time, 1, INSTR(champ_time, ':') - 1) AS c_hour,
        SUBSTR(SUBSTR(champ_time, INSTR(champ_time, ':') + 1), 1, INSTR(SUBSTR(champ_time, INSTR(champ_time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS c_min,
        SUBSTR(SUBSTR(champ_time, INSTR(champ_time, ':') + 1), INSTR(SUBSTR(champ_time, INSTR(champ_time, ':') + 1), ':') + 1) AS c_sec_ms
    FROM champ
),
champ_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        c_hour,
        c_min,
        CASE WHEN INSTR(c_sec_ms, '.') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(c_sec_ms, 1, INSTR(c_sec_ms, '.') - 1) ELSE c_sec_ms END AS c_sec,
        CASE WHEN INSTR(c_sec_ms, '.') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(c_sec_ms, INSTR(c_sec_ms, '.') + 1) ELSE '0' END AS c_ms
    FROM champ_parse
),
champ_ms AS (
    SELECT CAST(c_hour AS INTEGER) * 3600000 + CAST(c_min AS INTEGER) * 60000 + CAST(c_sec AS INTEGER) * 1000 + CAST(c_ms AS INTEGER) AS champ_millis
    FROM champ_parts
),
gap_clean AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN SUBSTR(gap_time, 1, 1) = '+' THEN SUBSTR(gap_time, 2) ELSE gap_time END AS g_time
    FROM last
),
gap_parse AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN INSTR(g_time, ':') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(g_time, 1, INSTR(g_time, ':') - 1) ELSE '0' END AS g_min,
        CASE WHEN INSTR(g_time, ':') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(g_time, INSTR(g_time, ':') + 1) ELSE g_time END AS g_sec_ms
    FROM gap_clean
),
gap_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        g_min,
        CASE WHEN INSTR(g_sec_ms, '.') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(g_sec_ms, 1, INSTR(g_sec_ms, '.') - 1) ELSE g_sec_ms END AS g_sec,
        CASE WHEN INSTR(g_sec_ms, '.') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(g_sec_ms, INSTR(g_sec_ms, '.') + 1) ELSE '0' END AS g_ms
    FROM gap_parse
),
gap_ms AS (
    SELECT CAST(g_min AS INTEGER) * 60000 + CAST(g_sec AS INTEGER) * 1000 + CAST(g_ms AS INTEGER) AS gap_millis
    FROM gap_parts
)
SELECT (gap_millis * 100.0) / (champ_millis + gap_millis) AS percentage_faster
FROM champ_ms, gap_ms;

SELECT champ.year, AVG(
  CAST(substr(res.time, 1, instr(res.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 +
  CAST(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1, 2) AS REAL) * 60 +
  CAST(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':', 1, 2) + 1) AS REAL)
) AS avg_seconds
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN (
  SELECT year, driverId
  FROM (
    SELECT r.year, ds.driverId, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(ds.points) DESC) AS rnk
    FROM driverStandings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year < 1975
    GROUP BY r.year, ds.driverId
  )
  WHERE rnk = 1
) champ ON r.year = champ.year AND res.driverId = champ.driverId
WHERE res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY champ.year
ORDER BY champ.year

        lt.milliseconds,
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
        r.year,
        r.name AS race_name,
        lt.lap,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.circuitId ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC) AS rnk
    FROM italy_circuits c
    JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    JOIN lapTimes lt ON r.raceId = lt.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT SUM(CAST(ps.duration AS REAL)) AS total_pit_stop_duration_seconds
FROM pitStops ps
JOIN (
    WITH circuit AS (
        SELECT circuitId FROM circuits WHERE country = 'Austria' AND location = 'Spielberg'
    ),
    circuit_races AS (
        SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE circuitId = (SELECT circuitId FROM circuit)
    ),
    lap_times_sec AS (
        SELECT r.raceId, r.driverId,
               CAST(SUBSTR(r.fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(r.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(r.fastestLapTime, INSTR(r.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS lap_seconds
        FROM results r
        JOIN circuit_races cr ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
        WHERE r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL AND r.fastestLapTime != '' AND r.fastestLapTime != '\N'
    ),
    min_lap AS (
        SELECT MIN(lap_seconds) AS min_seconds FROM lap_times_sec
    ),
    record_holder AS (
        SELECT raceId, driverId
        FROM lap_times_sec
        WHERE lap_seconds = (SELECT min_seconds FROM min_lap)
    )
    SELECT * FROM record_holder
) rh ON ps.raceId = rh.raceId AND ps.driverId = rh.driverId
WHERE ps.duration IS NOT NULL;

WITH event_parking_cost AS (
    SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, COALESCE(SUM(ex.cost), 0) AS total_parking_cost
    FROM event e
    INNER JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event AND b.category = 'Parking'
    LEFT JOIN expense ex ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
avg_parking_cost AS (
    SELECT SUM(total_parking_cost) / COUNT(event_id) AS avg_cost
    FROM event_parking_cost
)
SELECT epc.event_name
FROM event_parking_cost epc
CROSS JOIN avg_parking_cost apc
WHERE epc.total_parking_cost < apc.avg_cost;

SELECT AVG(ym.Consumption) / 12 AS AverageMonthlyConsumption
FROM yearmonth ym

SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201101' AND '201112'
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
HAVING SUM(ym.Consumption) = (
    SELECT MAX(TotalConsumption)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(ym2.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
        FROM customers c2
        JOIN yearmonth ym2 ON c2.CustomerID = ym2.CustomerID
        WHERE c2.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym2.Date BETWEEN '201101' AND '201112'
        GROUP BY c2.CustomerID
    ) AS sub
)
ORDER BY TotalConsumption DESC;

SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_min END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_min END) AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_min END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_min END) AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_min END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_min END) AS Diff_KAM_SME
FROM (
    SELECT Segment, AVG(total_cons) AS avg_min
    FROM (
        SELECT Segment, total_cons,
               RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY total_cons) AS rn
        FROM (
            SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_cons
            FROM customers c
            JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
            WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
              AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
              AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
            GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
        )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
    GROUP BY Segment
)

SELECT Segment, pct_increase, type
FROM (
    SELECT Segment, pct_increase, 'biggest' AS type
    FROM (
        SELECT c.Segment,
               (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
                SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
                NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pct_increase
        FROM customers c
        JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
        WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
          AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
          AND substr(y.Date,1,4) IN ('2012', '2013')
        GROUP BY c.Segment
    )
    WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MAX(pct_increase)
                          FROM (
                              SELECT c.Segment,
                                     (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
                                      SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
                                      NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pct_increase
                              FROM customers c
                              JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
                              WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
                                AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
                                AND substr(y.Date,1,4) IN ('2012', '2013')
                              GROUP BY c.Segment
                          )
                         )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Segment, pct_increase, 'lowest' AS type
    FROM (
        SELECT c.Segment,
               (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
                SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
                NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pct_increase
        FROM customers c
        JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
        WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
          AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
          AND substr(y.Date,1,4) IN ('2012', '2013')
        GROUP BY c.Segment
    )
    WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MIN(pct_increase)
                          FROM (
                              SELECT c.Segment,
                                     (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
                                      SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
                                      NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pct_increase
                              FROM customers c
                              JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
                              WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
                                AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
                                AND substr(y.Date,1,4) IN ('2012', '2013')
                              GROUP BY c.Segment
                          )
                         )
)

WITH station_prices AS (
    SELECT t.GasStationID,
           g.Country,
           SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_unit_price
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    WHERE t.Amount > 0 AND t.Price IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.GasStationID, g.Country
),
country_avg AS (
    SELECT Country, AVG(avg_unit_price) AS avg_country_price
    FROM station_prices
    GROUP BY Country
)
SELECT sp.Country, COUNT(*) AS value_for_money_count
FROM station_prices sp
JOIN country_avg ca ON sp.Country = ca.Country
WHERE sp.avg_unit_price < ca.avg_country_price
GROUP BY sp.Country
ORDER BY value_for_money_count DESC;
